# Compressonator CMP_Core (vendored subset)

Unmodified files from the AMD Compressonator V4.6.0 release
(https://github.com/GPUOpen-Tools/compressonator, tag `V4.6.0`, tarball
sha256 `4e64d84336689763a107feff76275d59080a329d14242c55e2273f7319530743`),
limited to what the BC1-BC7 block encoders need. Licensed under the MIT
license in `license/corelicense.txt`.

Do not edit these files. Regenerate them with
`python3 -I tools/vendor_compressonator.py`; local fixes are applied by
`build.rs` when the library is compiled, and the build fails if a fix no
longer applies.
